notes: The ASV inverts τῆς χειρὸς τοῦ παιδίου into 'the child by the hand'; each article keeps its own determiner and the case preposition rides with τῆς under rule 21, following the ASV's phrasing per rule 25.
Τό before the bare vocative κοράσιον is unrepresented, the ASV supplying neither determiner nor address word (rules 23 and 89).
